name: v1.0.2
body:
Warning! This release is NOT intended for manual install!
Please use [XXMI Launcher](https://github.com/SpectrumQT/XXMI-Launcher/releases/latest) to install it!

## Hotfixes
- [v1.0.2]: Fixed reported issues (WuWa freeze on start & ghost on quit; random objects disappearance)

## Extended INI Language
- Added expressions support to global variable declaration and section options (parsing time evaluation).
	* `global $var = $existing + 1`.
- Added proxy mode for CommandLists (similar to copy-by-reference for resources). Supports chaining.
	* Set Proxy: `CommandListFoo = ref CommandListBar`, allowing `run = CommandListFoo` to execute `CommandListBar`
	* Reset Proxy: `CommandListFoo = null`
- Added VB input layout override commands:
	* Override Format: `vb0->ElementFormat(BLENDINDICES, 0) = R16G16B16A16_UINT`.
	* Override AlignedByteOffset: `vb0->ElementOffset(BLENDWEIGHTS, 0) = 8`.
- Added native support for constant buffers with regions (defined via FirstConstant and NumConstants).
    - So `ResourceFoo = ref vs-cb0` or `ResourceFoo = copy vs-cb0` now capture only currently visible region.
- Added `->Offset` attribute getter which returns byte offset to currently configured CB/IB/VB region.
    - Basically it converts FirstConstant, FirstIndex and FirstVertex respectively into a byte offset.
- Added `->Region($byte_offset, $byte_size)` specifier for copies. Offset must be absolute. Experimental.
	* `cs-cb0 = copy vs-cb0->Region($byte_offset, $byte_size)` copies an arbitrary portion of the underlying buffer.
	* `cs-cb0 = ref vs-cb0->Region($byte_offset, $byte_size)` binds the same underlying buffer with a different view.
- Added evaluatable keywords:
	* `FRAME_NUMBER`: returns number of current frame (where frame boundary is `Present` call).
	* `DRAW_NUMBER`: returns number of current `draw` call. Starts with 1 for new frame.
	* `DISPATCH_NUMBER`: returns number of current `dispatch` call. Starts with 1 for new frame.
- Added bunch of HLSL-style unary functions for usage in expressions.
	* **Math:** abs, sign, ceil, floor, trunc, round, frac, sqrt, rsqrt, exp, exp2, log, log2
	* **Trigonometry:** sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan
	* **Other:** countbits, saturate, random, noise
- Added "locked" keyword to variables (e.g. `global locked $var = 1.23`). Prevents usage as value assignment targets.
- Added dynamically evaluatable expression support for `store` read offset (e.g. `store = $out, vs-cb0, $base_offset + 128`).
- Added binary literals support (e.g. `global $var = 0b01010111`). Max length is 24 (`float` container limitation).
- Increased recursion limit to 256.

## Optimizations
- Reduced overall latency of `store` command by 30%.
- Added `constant_buffer` bind flag conflict detection at INI parsing time with proper error reporting.

## Overhauls
- Reworked pools with INI variables pools, expressions support, full range operations and more. For testing only.
	* Official release and documentation will happen in the next DLL update. Stay tuned.
